newsitem.title: EU: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, June 16 - Sunday, June 22.
newsitem.headline: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, June 16 - Sunday, June 22.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS

AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (Mon-Tues); the formal agenda will focus on the conclusion of the EU's inter-governmental conference (IGC), progress of Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) and the well-being of citizens including environment, transparency, democracy and the fight against organised crime and drugs.
LUXEMBOURG - EU transport ministers meet (Tues-Wed).
BRUSSELS - European Commission regular meeting (Weds).
LUXEMBOURG - EU environment ministers meet (Thurs-Fri).

DENVER, United States (EXPANDED ITEM) - Group of Seven (Britain, U.S., Canada, France, Germany, Italy and Japan) hold summit (Fri-Sun). European Commission President Santer, European Commissioners Brittan and de Silguy attend.
MONDAY, JUNE 16
AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (and Tues).
Agenda includes:
- (0930/0730 GMT) First working session at the Dutch Central Bank building includes:
- Discussions on any outstanding questions related to the inter-governmental conference (IGC) especially examining the matter of "The Union and citizens" with particular emphasis on employment.

- In parallel, finance ministers will discuss the proposed European Council resolution on employment to accompany the resolution on the stability pact and European Monetary Union II - could continue over lunch.
- (1245/1045 GMT) Dutch Queen Beatrix hosts lunch in honour of European Council members and European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil Robles. Venue: Royal Palace on the Dam.
- (1515/1315 GMT) Second working session continues on the inter-governmental conference (IGC).
- (1700/1500 GMT) Third working session, in presence of finance ministers, devoted to employment in general and Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
- (2030/1830 GMT) Over dinner, heads of government will continue deliberations on the inter-governmental conference (IGC). Venue: Rijksmuseum.
A separate dinner for foreign ministers will provide an opportunity to discuss foreign policy including the Middle East peace process and the situation in former Yugoslavia, Albania and Congo.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Foreign Affairs Committee - NATO Secretary General Javier Solana attends (1500/1300 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Fisheries Committee holds public hearing on "Fishing effort and sustainable dvelopment".
TUESDAY, JUNE 17
AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (second of two days).
Agenda includes:
- (0930/0730 GMT) Fourth working session to finalize any outstanding questions on the inter-governmental conference (IGC) and Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
- (1330/1130 GMT) Heads of government lunch. Venue: Amstel Hotel.
- (1500/1300 GMT) Final working session - followed by a closing news conference at the Carre Theatre (no time availble yet).

LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU transport ministers meet (1000/0800 GMT) (and Wed). Agenda includes third countries' air security; air traffic management; Eurovignette; trans-European rail corridors; promoting road safety in Europe; seafarer training; sea passenger registration; maritime transport negotiations with India and China; short distance sea transport.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Agriculture Committee - European Commissioner Fischler gives address on Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) (1500/1300 GMT).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Economic Committee - European Commissioner Van Miert gives address on the Commission's annual report on competition and matters of current interest (1500/1300 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Budgetary Control Committee - European Commissioner Marin attends.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Development Committee - Dutch Development Minister Jan Pronk (1500/1300 GMT), European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro (1700/1500 GMT) attend.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Subcommittee on Human rights holds public hearing on "The social clause: Human rights promotion or protectionism?" (1500/1300 GMT).

BRUSSELS - European Food Law sixth annual conference (and Wednesday). Main issues discussed are food safety, genetically modified foods and food law. Speakers include: Head of Commission Directorate-General XXIV (Consumer Policy) Horst Reichenbach. Venue: Radisson Hotel. WEDNESDAY, JUNE 18
LUXEMBOURG (NEW ITEM) - EU transport ministers meet (second of two days).
BRUSSELS - European Commission regular meeting (0900/0700 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- International regulation of nuclear non-proliferation.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Economic Committee - Dutch Finance Minister attends (1500/1300 GMT).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Social Affairs Committee - European Commissioner Flynn gives address on the outcome of the Social Affairs Council and Amsterdam European summit (1700/1500 GMT).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Institutional Affairs Committee - EP President Jose Maria Gil Robles and European Commissioner Oreja give address on the outcome of the Amsterdam European summit (1500/1300 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Cultural Affairs Committee holds public hearing on "Promotion of music in Europe and the role of the EU" (0900/0700 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Swiss Military Department Head Adolf Ogi meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (0940/0740 GMT).
THURSDAY, JUNE 19

LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU environment ministers meet (and Fri). Agenda includes implementation of Community environment law; control of road transport emissions; petrol and diesel fuel quality; directive on water (public hearing at 1600/1400 GMT); climate change; use of organic solvants; fight against acidification; quality of water for human consumption; humane trapping standards with Russia and Canada; waste disposal.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Consumers Union Bureau (BEUC) holds n/conf on "Car insurance across Europe" (1100/0900 GMT). Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: BEUC (322) 542 3211.

BRUSSELS - European Institute for Asian Studies holds lunchtime meeting on "Is China's WTO accession in sight" (1230/1030 GMT). Venue: 35 avenue des Deux Eglises. Contact: Zoe McCarthy (322) 230 8122.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "What happened at the European Council in Amsterdam, June 16-17 - How will the EU decisions affect business?" (1230/1030 GMT). Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
FRIDAY, JUNE 20
LUXEMBOURG (NEW ITEM) - EU environment ministers meet (second of two days).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Monti attends "Taxation Policy Group" meeting. Venue: Borschette Centre.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "Agricultural and rural development policy for the 21st century" (1315/1115 GMT). Speaker is: European Commissioner Fischler. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

DENVER, United States (EXPANDED ITEM) - Group of Seven (Britain, U.S., Canada, France, Germany, Italy and Japan) hold summit (to Sun). European Commission President Santer, European Commissioners Brittan and de Silguy attend.
SATURDAY, JUNE 21
No events scheduled.
SUNDAY, JUNE 22
No events scheduled.
